description: Helping Hands live preview / compare pages (e.g. Two Finger Gripper versions compare.html): every object must always have a toggle to turn its reference photo on or off, and when on, the reference photo shows inline alongside the object's renders, the same way the other views can be shown. Make this the standard in the compare template so all versions get it. Jake (voice, 2026-10-20): 'we should always be able to turn the reference photo on or off for a given object, so I should be able to view the reference photo in line with this one just like I can view other' views.
test_instructions: Open the live compare page: each object has a reference-photo toggle.
Toggle on: the reference photo appears inline next to the object's views; toggle off: it hides.

results.identified_issue: The live preview (cad/mobile_gallery) is the compare template every version uses now; the old per-version compare.html pages under Two Finger Gripper/versions/v007-v011b are frozen snapshots (they already show photos) and were left alone. The photo tile replaces the old Actual (Generalist) tile removed in voice-1a2680b8. Photos are per design family (reference/photos.js, written by make_reference.py), not per version: all Generalist parts share the gen6 photos. Only Generalist Gripper has photos; Aero/Glove/Orca/Your hand show the row greyed. The photo is a flat tile, not overlaid in 3D (the old Y=0 aligned plane is not restored). Removed the .focused grid CSS rule; placePhoto() now sets --columns/--rows for views + photo. Tested with Scripts/test_gallery.py (3 new headless-Chrome tests) and a SwiftShader screenshot of the live server.
results.summary: Every design in the live preview now has a Reference photo toggle; on, the real photo sits inline beside the 3D view
results.detailed_description: The top of every design's parts list now has a 'Reference photo' row with the same eye button as the parts. Tap it on and the real gripper photo appears as its own tile right beside the 3D view (side by side when you're looking at one assembly, one more tile when comparing versions), with a small picker in the tile's corner to choose which photo: Top (aligned), Top around a bowl, Both hands, Side, Closed, Holding a cup, On the robot, Camera, Target. It stays on as you switch versions or families. Because it's built into the live preview page itself, every version gets it automatically. Right now only the Generalist Gripper has reference photos; the Aero, Glove and Orca hands still show the row, greyed out as 'No reference photo yet', and adding their photos is one entry in cad/mobile_gallery/reference/make_reference.py. You can also link straight to it with ?photo=1 or ?photo=side. The photo is a flat picture next to the model, not laid over it in 3D.

visual.alt: Live preview: model and reference photo side by side, toggle at top of parts list

summary: Helping Hands compare pages, such as the Two Finger Gripper versions, lack a reliable per-object toggle for showing its reference photo inline. Every object should always offer that toggle, with the photo shown beside its renders like other views, built into the compare template for all versions.
